label: Mob Farmer
tooltip: Choose which enemies to farm and how pulls work.

should_handle_targeting.label: Auto-target enemies
should_handle_targeting.tooltip: While fighting, BOCCHI picks and switches targets for you.

force_target_central_enemy.label: Prefer the middle of the pack
force_target_central_enemy.tooltip: Target the enemy nearest the pack center instead of the closest one. Needs Auto-target enemies.

consider_special_mobs.label: Include special enemies
consider_special_mobs.tooltip: Also pull and count special enemies that only appear in certain weather or times of day.

count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.label: Count specials toward minimums
count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.tooltip: When off, specials can still be pulled, but they do not count toward the start / fight minimums below.

only_start_out_of_combat.label: Wait until combat fully ends
only_start_out_of_combat.tooltip: Do not start a new pull until you are fully out of combat. If something is already attacking you, fighting still starts.

max_mob_level.label: Max enemy level
max_mob_level.tooltip: Ignore enemies above this level. Handy when specials or mixed-level packs are around.

max_euclidean_distance.label: Max pull range
max_euclidean_distance.tooltip: Ignore enemies farther than this (yalms). Stops a far-away special from dragging you across the map.

min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.label: Go home if farther than
min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.tooltip: After a fight, walk back to your start point only if you are farther away than this (yalms).

return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.label: Return to start after combat
return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.tooltip: Your start point is where you stood when you pressed Start. Uses a mount on the way back if auto-mount is on.

render_debug_lines.label: Show debug lines
render_debug_lines.tooltip: While farming: red lines to valid enemies out of combat, green lines while fighting.

apply_battle_bell.label: Use Battle Bell
apply_battle_bell.tooltip: Switch to Geomancer and cast Battle Bell before every pull (even if the buff is still up), then Sprint. Skips only if the cooldown is longer than the wait below.

maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.label: Max wait for Battle Bell
maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.tooltip: If Battle Bell needs longer than this to come off cooldown, skip it and pull anyway.

minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.label: Minimum enemies to start
minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.tooltip: How many valid enemies must be nearby before a new pull begins.

minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.label: Minimum enemies before fighting
minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.tooltip: How many enemies to gather before stopping to fight. If nothing else is left to pull nearby, fighting starts early.

stacking_timeout_seconds.label: Gather timeout (seconds)
stacking_timeout_seconds.tooltip: Max time spent running to gather enemies before fighting starts anyway.

mobs.label: Enemy list
mobs.tooltip: Which enemies the farmer will pull and count.
